Object-layer scan of boutique pods shows exactly one outlier: productcatalogservice-6df94d8f6b-vjgld 1/2 OOMKilled, 4 restarts, container 'server' Terminated Reason=OOMKilled Exit Code=137 with 128Mi limit, and kubelet event 'BackOff - Back-off restarting failed container server'. GetServiceDependencies shows productcatalogservice is the leaf called by frontend, checkoutservice and recommendationservice, matching all alerted entities. Source code of product_catalog.go contains an injected per-request loop in ListProducts that opens /src/log.csv and calls csv.ReadAll() 15 times (excessive file reads), unlike upstream which returns parseCatalog() directly; this inflates latency and memory each request until the 128Mi limit is breached and the process is OOMKilled. The 128Mi limit equals the stock value used by peer boutique services and no namespace ResourceQuota exists, so configuration is not the anomaly - the code path is.
